entries.5b54fa001b907a07: This business division focuses mainly on building business systems and providing services. It builds core business systems for companies (sales management, production management, purchasing management and accounting management, among others), develops systems for mobile telecommunications operators (mobile phone subscriber management and accounting management), designs and develops network and system infrastructure, and provides outsourcing services (operation, maintenance and similar). In the fiscal year ended February 2026, revenue was ¥15,901 million.
entries.70e9befe19a67131: This business division focuses mainly on commissioned development of solutions using IoT and AI and big data analytics technologies, and of embedded and control systems. It builds logistics DX solutions and IoT solutions for livestock DX and smart cities, handles AI and big data analytics and security-related products, develops embedded product software, builds control application systems for industrial and public use (such as flow and water quality management for water and sewerage), and builds and operates information and communication infrastructure for local governments. In the fiscal year ended February 2026, revenue was ¥4,361 million.

entries.c183ad8bc133d406: This is a single segment providing information processing services, including the construction and operation of information systems and the development and sale of information processing software. The group consists of 3 companies in total: the company itself, 1 consolidated subsidiary (YE DIGITAL Kyushu Corporation, voting rights ownership 96.7%), and 1 equity-method affiliate (Aikyubu Digital Corporation, voting rights ownership 40.0%). The company outsources part of its software development and system operation and maintenance to YE DIGITAL Kyushu Corporation, and receives engineers dispatched from it. In the fiscal year ended February 2026, revenue was ¥20,263 million.
